description: The China Flood Catastrophe Model 2.0 is a commercial catastrophe model released by China Re Catastrophe Risk Management, a subsidiary of the China Reinsurance Group, for quantifying insured flood losses in China. The news page read on 2026-09-28 (a Xinhua report of 25 October 2024) says the commercial edition was launched on 23 October 2024 at the Shanghai International Reinsurance Conference, developed with the Chinese Academy of Meteorological Sciences, the China Institute of Water Resources and Hydropower Research and Tianjin University's state key laboratory for hydraulic engineering simulation; it generates a 10,000-year stochastic rainfall event set reflecting China's monsoon climate, uses a library of flood model algorithms of several types and scales on a high-throughput computing framework, has passed expert review, and completes a family with the company's earthquake and typhoon models. Coverage is national. Access is commercial for insurers; the model is proprietary and no licence for public use exists. Caveats: methods and validation are not published on the page, and results serve insurance portfolios, not asset-level engineering. It supports flood hazard exposure and loss estimation for portfolios of buildings and infrastructure in China. No related Chinese catastrophe model record is catalogued.
